mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, trigger_id, trigger_name, suite_code, object_code, record_id, event_type, event_id, event_source, event_version, event_digest, event_data, trigger_snapshot, execution_digest, action_type, action_result, execute_status, error_message, todo_code, correlation_id, execute_time, duration_ms, retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_owner, lock_time, create_time
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_trigger_log SET execute_status = #{log.executeStatus}, action_result = #{log.actionResult}, error_message = #{log.errorMessage}, todo_code = #{log.todoCode}, correlation_id = #{log.correlationId}, duration_ms = #{log.durationMs}, retry_count = #{log.retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{log.nextRetryTime}, lock_owner = NULL, lock_time = NULL WHERE id = #{log.id} AND tenant_id = #{log.tenantId} AND execute_status = 'PENDING' AND lock_owner = #{log.lockOwner}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_business_trigger_log WHERE retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND event_source != 'LEGACY' AND trigger_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND execution_digest IS NOT NULL AND ( (execute_status = 'PENDING' AND (lock_time IS NULL OR lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) OR (execute_status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_time <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY execute_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_trigger_log SET execute_status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = NULL, lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, lock_time = #{now}, execute_time = #{now}, action_result = NULL, error_message = NULL, todo_code = NULL, correlation_id = NULL, duration_ms = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( (execute_status = 'PENDING' AND (lock_time IS NULL OR lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) OR (execute_status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_time <= #{now}) )
